def verifier.candidate.canonical_scan
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error)
  := do
  let i ← compact.OFF_Y1
  let i1 ← compact.OFF_INACTIVE
  let s ←
    core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
      Std.U8) proof { start := i, «end» := i1 }
  let r ← compact.check_values s
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    let i2 ← i1 + 32#usize
    let s1 ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
        Std.U8) proof { start := i1, «end» := i2 }
    let r1 ← verifier.echeck s1 false
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let i3 ← compact.OFF_ROUND0
      let i4 ← compact.OFF_FOLDED_ROOT
      let s2 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) proof
          { start := i3, «end» := i4 }
      let r2 ← verifier.echeck s2 false
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        let i5 ← compact.OFF_ROUND1
        let i6 ← compact.OFF_OPENINGS
        let s3 ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) proof
            { start := i5, «end» := i6 }
        let r3 ← verifier.echeck s3 false
        let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
        match cf3 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
          let pending_return ←
            verifier.candidate.canonical_scan_loop0
              { start := 0#usize, «end» := 22#usize } proof none
          match pending_return with
          | none => fail panic
          | some r4 => ok r4
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      Unit verifier.Error.Insts.CoreConvertFromCodecError residual

def verifier.candidate.batch_keys_loop.body
  (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (lo : Std.Usize) (tree : Std.Usize)
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) × (Array Std.U64
    16#usize)) (Array Std.U64 16#usize))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done keys)
  | some j =>
    let i ← lo + j
    let u ← Array.index_usize queries i
    let index ← if tree = 2#usize
                  then u / 4#u32
                  else ok u
    let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from index)
    let i2 ← i1 <<< 8#i32
    let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 j)
    let i4 ← lift (i2 ||| i3)
    let keys1 ← Array.update keys j i4
    ok (cont (iter1, keys1))

def verifier.candidate.sort_batch_keys_loop0_loop0.body
  (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U64 16#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U64
    16#usize))
  := do
  if j > 0#usize
  then
    let i ← j - 1#usize
    let i1 ← verifier.candidate.batch_key_at keys i
    let i2 ← verifier.candidate.batch_key_at keys j
    if i1 > i2
    then
      let (s, to_slice_mut_back) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut keys)
      let s1 ← core.slice.Slice.swap s i j
      let keys1 := to_slice_mut_back s1
      ok (cont (keys1, i))
    else ok (done keys)
  else ok (done keys)

      aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash i s1 salt
  | 1 =>
    let s ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
        Std.U8) q { start := 640#usize, «end» := 672#usize }

  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (values : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (index : Std.Usize) (sibling : Slice Std.U8) (left : Bool) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  := do
  if left
  then
    let s ←
      lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ multiproof.BINARY_NODE_TAG ]))
    let a ← Array.index_usize values index
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, s1, sibling ]))
    aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest hash s2
  else
    let s ←
      lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ multiproof.BINARY_NODE_TAG ]))
    let a ← Array.index_usize values index
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, sibling, s1 ]))
    aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest hash s2

def multiproof.occupied_binary_parent
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (values : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (index : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  := do
  let s ←
    lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ multiproof.BINARY_NODE_TAG ]))
  let a ← Array.index_usize values index
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
  let i ← index + 1#usize
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize values i
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, s1, s2 ]))
  aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest hash s3

  (values : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result Bool
  := do

  core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a root

def multiproof.well_formed (indices : Slice Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← core.slice.Slice.is_empty indices
  if b
  then ok false
  else
    let i := Slice.len indices
    if i <= multiproof.MAX_BATCH
    then
      let w ← core.slice.Slice.windows indices 2#usize
      let (b1, _) ←
        core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.all.default
          (core.slice.iter.Windows.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorSharedASlice
          Std.U32)
          multiproof.well_formed.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedSliceU32Bool
          w ()
      if b1
      then
        let i1 ← core.slice.Slice.iter indices
        let (b2, _) ←
          core.slice.iter.Iter.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorSharedAT.all
            multiproof.well_formed.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU32Bool
            i1 ()
        ok b2
      else ok false
    else ok false

  (pending_return : Option Bool)

  (Array Std.U8 32#usize)))
  (back : core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate (core.slice.iter.IterMut
  (Array Std.U8 32#usize)) → core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate
  (core.slice.iter.IterMut (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) (at1 : Std.Usize)

  Result (ControlFlow ((core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) ×
    (core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate (core.slice.iter.IterMut (Array
    Std.U8 32#usize)) → core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut (Array Std.U8 32#usize))) × Std.Usize ×
    Std.Usize) (Std.Usize × Std.Usize × (Option Bool) ×
    (core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate (core.slice.iter.IterMut (Array
    Std.U8 32#usize)))))
  := do

    core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next
      (core.slice.iter.IterMut.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorMutAT (Array
      Std.U8 32#usize)) iter
  match o with
  | none =>
    let e := next_back iter1 none
    ok (done (at1, i, pending_return, back e))
  | some p =>
    let (slot, child) := p
    if i < n
    then
      let i1 ← multiproof.index_at idx i
      let i2 ← i1 >>> 3#i32
      if i2 = parent
      then
        let i3 ← lift (i1 &&& 7#u32)
        let i4 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i3)
        if i4 = slot
        then
          let child1 ← multiproof.value_at val i
          let i5 ← i + 1#usize
          ok (cont (iter1,
            fun e => let e1 := next_back e (some (slot, child1))
                     back e1, at1, i5))
        else
          let i5 ← at1 + 32#usize
          let o1 ←
            core.slice.Slice.get (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
              Std.U8) nodes { start := at1, «end» := i5 }
          match o1 with
          | none =>
            let e := next_back iter1 o
            ok (done (at1, i, some false, back e))
          | some sibling =>
            let (s, to_slice_mut_back) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut child)
            let s1 ←
              core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s sibling
            let child1 := to_slice_mut_back s1
            ok (cont (iter1,
              fun e => let e1 := next_back e (some (slot, child1))
                       back e1, i5, i))
      else

        let o1 ←
          core.slice.Slice.get (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice

@[rust_loop_body]
def multiproof.verify_in_place_loop0_loop0.body
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (n : Std.Usize) (nodes : Slice Std.U8) (arity : multiproof.Arity)
  (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (at1 : Std.Usize) (w : Std.Usize) (i : Std.Usize)
  (pending_return : Option Bool) :
  Result (ControlFlow (multiproof.Arity × (Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array
    (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) × Std.Usize × Std.Usize × Std.Usize ×
    (Option Bool)) (multiproof.Arity × (Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array
    (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) × Std.Usize × Std.Usize × (Option
    Bool) × Std.U32))
  := do
  if i < n
  then
    let i1 ← multiproof.index_at idx i
    let i2 ← multiproof.Arity.bits arity
    let parent ← i1 >>> i2
    match arity with
    | multiproof.Arity.Two =>
      let i3 ← i + 1#usize
      if i3 < n
      then
        let i4 ← multiproof.index_at idx i3
        let i5 ← lift (i1 ^^^ 1#u32)
        if i4 = i5
        then
          let d ←
            multiproof.occupied_binary_parent aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash
              val i
          let i6 ← i + 2#usize
          let idx1 ← Array.update idx w parent
          let val1 ← Array.update val w d
          let w1 ← w + 1#usize
          ok (cont (multiproof.Arity.Two, idx1, val1, at1, w1, i6,
            pending_return))
        else
          let i6 ← at1 + 32#usize
          let o ←
            core.slice.Slice.get (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
              Std.U8) nodes { start := at1, «end» := i6 }
          match o with
          | none =>
            ok (done (multiproof.Arity.Two, idx, val, n, at1, some false,
              0#u32))
          | some sibling =>
            let i7 ← lift (i1 &&& 1#u32)
            let d ←
              multiproof.sibling_binary_parent aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
                hash val i sibling (i7 = 0#u32)
            let idx1 ← Array.update idx w parent
            let val1 ← Array.update val w d
            let w1 ← w + 1#usize
            ok (cont (multiproof.Arity.Two, idx1, val1, i6, w1, i3,
              pending_return))
      else
        let i4 ← at1 + 32#usize
        let o ←
          core.slice.Slice.get (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
            Std.U8) nodes { start := at1, «end» := i4 }
        match o with
        | none =>
          ok (done (multiproof.Arity.Two, idx, val, n, at1, some false, 0#u32))
        | some sibling =>
          let i5 ← lift (i1 &&& 1#u32)
          let d ←
            multiproof.sibling_binary_parent aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash
              val i sibling (i5 = 0#u32)
          let idx1 ← Array.update idx w parent
          let val1 ← Array.update val w d
          let w1 ← w + 1#usize
          ok (cont (multiproof.Arity.Two, idx1, val1, i4, w1, i3,
            pending_return))
    | multiproof.Arity.Eight =>
      let a := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
      let children := Array.repeat 8#usize a
      let (s, to_slice_mut_back) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut children)
      let (im, iter_mut_back) ← core.slice.Slice.iter_mut s
      let (iter, enumerate_back) ←
        core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default
          (core.slice.iter.IterMut.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorMutAT
          (Array Std.U8 32#usize)) im
      let (at2, i3, pending_return1, back) ←
        multiproof.verify_in_place_loop0_loop0_loop0 iter (fun e => e) idx val
          n nodes at1 i parent pending_return
      match pending_return1 with
      | none =>
        let im1 := enumerate_back back
        let s1 := iter_mut_back im1
        let children1 := to_slice_mut_back s1
        let digest ←
          aspis_core.r0.merkle.parent_with_digest aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
            hash children1
        let idx1 ← Array.update idx w parent
        let val1 ← Array.update val w digest
        let w1 ← w + 1#usize
        ok (cont (multiproof.Arity.Eight, idx1, val1, at2, w1, i3, none))
      | some _ =>
        ok (done (multiproof.Arity.Eight, idx, val, n, at2, pending_return1,
          0#u32))
  else ok (done (arity, idx, val, w, at1, pending_return, 1#u32))

def multiproof.verify_in_place_loop0.body
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (nodes : Slice Std.U8)
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) (arity : multiproof.Arity)
  (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (n : Std.Usize) (at1 : Std.Usize) (pending_return : Option Bool) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.U32) × multiproof.Arity ×
    (Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) ×
    Std.Usize × Std.Usize × (Option Bool)) ((Array Std.U32 16#usize) ×
    (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) × (Option Bool)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepU32 iter
  match o with
  | none =>
    if n = 1#usize
    then
      let i ← multiproof.index_at idx 0#usize
      if i = 0#u32
      then
        let b ← multiproof.root_matches val root
        if b
        then let i1 := Slice.len nodes
             ok (done (idx, val, some (at1 = i1)))
        else ok (done (idx, val, some false))
      else ok (done (idx, val, some false))
    else ok (done (idx, val, some false))
  | some _ =>
    let (arity1, idx1, val1, n1, at2, pending_return1, i) ←
      multiproof.verify_in_place_loop0_loop0 aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash
        arity idx val n nodes at1 0#usize 0#usize pending_return
    match i with
    | 1#uscalar =>
      ok (cont (iter1, arity1, idx1, val1, n1, at2, pending_return1))
    | _ =>
      match pending_return1 with
      | none => ok (done (idx1, val1, none))
      | some _ => ok (done (idx1, val1, pending_return1))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::multiproof::verify_in_place]:

    Visibility: public -/
def multiproof.verify_in_place
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (arity : multiproof.Arity) (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (n : Std.Usize) (nodes : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (Bool × (Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize)
    16#usize))
  := do
  if n = 0#usize
  then ok (false, idx, val)
  else
    if n > multiproof.MAX_BATCH
    then ok (false, idx, val)
    else
      let s ←
        core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U32)) idx
          { «end» := n }
      let b ← multiproof.well_formed s
      if b
      then
        let i := Slice.len nodes
        let i1 ← i % 32#usize
        if i1 != 0#usize
        then ok (false, idx, val)
        else
          let i2 ← multiproof.Arity.levels arity
          let (idx1, val1, pending_return) ←
            multiproof.verify_in_place_loop0 aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
              { start := 0#u32, «end» := i2 } hash arity root idx val n nodes
              0#usize none
          match pending_return with
          | none => fail panic
          | some b1 => ok (b1, idx1, val1)
      else ok (false, idx, val)

def multiproof.Arity.width (self : multiproof.Arity) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let i ← multiproof.Arity.bits self
  1#usize <<< i

def multiproof.node_count_loop0_loop0_loop0.body
  (arity : multiproof.Arity) (level : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (n : Std.Usize)
  (parent : Std.U32) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow Std.Usize Std.Usize)
  := do
  if j < n
  then
    let i ← multiproof.index_at level j
    let i1 ← multiproof.Arity.bits arity
    let i2 ← i >>> i1
    if i2 = parent
    then let j1 ← j + 1#usize
         ok (cont j1)
    else ok (done j)
  else ok (done j)

def multiproof.node_count
  (arity : multiproof.Arity) (indices : Slice Std.U32) :
  Result (Option Std.Usize)
  := do
  let b ← multiproof.well_formed indices
  if b
  then
    let level := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32
    let i := Slice.len indices
    let (s, index_mut_back) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U32)) level
        { «end» := i }
    let s1 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU32 s indices
    let level1 := index_mut_back s1
    let n := Slice.len indices
    let i1 ← multiproof.Arity.levels arity
    let count ←
      multiproof.node_count_loop0 { start := 0#u32, «end» := i1 } arity
        level1 n 0#usize
    ok (some count)
  else ok none

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::batch_tree]: loop body 0:

@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.candidate.batch_tree_loop.body
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (tree : Std.Usize)
  (hash : H) (lo : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize) (s : Std.Usize)
  (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize)
  (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) (d : Std.Usize)
  (key_position : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array (Array Std.U8
    32#usize) 16#usize) × Std.Usize × Std.Usize) ((Array Std.U32 16#usize) ×
    (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize) × (Option (core.result.Result
    Unit verifier.Error))))
  := do
  if key_position < n
  then
    let key ← verifier.candidate.batch_key_at keys key_position
    let key_position1 ← key_position + 1#usize
    let i ← key >>> 8#i32
    let index ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i)
    let i1 ← lift (key &&& 255#u64)
    let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i1)
    let i3 ← lo + i2
    let q ← verifier.candidate.opening proof i3
    let leaf ←
      verifier.candidate.batch_leaf aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash tree q
    if d > 0#usize
    then
      let i4 ← d - 1#usize
      let b ← verifier.candidate.same_batch_index idx i4 index
      if b
      then
        let b1 ← verifier.candidate.same_batch_leaf val i4 leaf
        if b1
        then ok (cont (idx, val, d, key_position1))
        else
          ok (done (idx, val, some (core.result.Result.Err
            verifier.Error.Merkle)))
      else
        let idx1 ← Array.update idx d index
        let val1 ← Array.update val d leaf
        let d1 ← d + 1#usize
        ok (cont (idx1, val1, d1, key_position1))
    else
      let idx1 ← Array.update idx d index
      let val1 ← Array.update val d leaf
      let d1 ← d + 1#usize
      ok (cont (idx1, val1, d1, key_position1))
  else
    let s1 ←
      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U32)) idx
        { «end» := d }
    let o ← multiproof.node_count multiproof.Arity.Two s1
    let r ← core.option.Option.ok_or o verifier.Error.Merkle
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
      let nodes ← verifier.candidate.slot proof s
      let i ← Array.index_usize compact.SLOT_NODES s
      if val1 > i
      then ok (done (idx, val, none))
      else
        let i1 ← 32#usize * val1
        let s2 ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) nodes
            { start := i1 }
        let ce ← core.slice.Slice.chunks_exact s2 8#usize
        let (b, _) ←
          core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.any.default
            (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorChunksExact Std.U8)
            (verifier.candidate.batch_tree.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedSliceU8Bool
            aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst) ce ()
        if b
        then ok (done (idx, val, none))
        else
          let s3 ←
            core.slice.index.Slice.index
              (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) nodes
              { «end» := i1 }
          let (b1, idx1, val2) ←
            multiproof.verify_in_place aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash
              multiproof.Arity.Two root idx val d s3
          if b1
          then ok (done (idx1, val2, some (core.result.Result.Ok ())))
          else ok (done (idx1, val2, none))
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let _ ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (done (idx, val, none))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::batch_tree]: loop 0:

@[rust_loop]
def verifier.candidate.batch_tree_loop
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (tree : Std.Usize)
  (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (hash : H) (lo : Std.Usize) (n : Std.Usize) (s : Std.Usize)
  (keys : Array Std.U64 16#usize) (d : Std.Usize) (key_position : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 16#usize) × (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
    × (Option (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error)))
  := do
  loop

      verifier.candidate.batch_tree_loop.body aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst

    (idx, val, d, key_position)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::batch_tree]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 173:0-206:1 -/
def verifier.candidate.batch_tree
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
  (root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (batch : Std.Usize) (tree : Std.Usize)
  (idx : Array Std.U32 16#usize) (val : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize)
  (hash : H) :
  Result ((core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error) × (Array Std.U32 16#usize)
    × (Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 16#usize))
  := do
  let (lo, hi) ←
    if batch = 0#usize
    then ok (0#usize, compact.SPLIT)
    else ok (compact.SPLIT, 22#usize)
  let n ← hi - lo
  let i ← 3#usize * batch
  let s ← i + tree
  let a ← verifier.candidate.batch_keys queries lo n tree
  let keys ← verifier.candidate.sort_batch_keys a n
  let (idx1, val1, pending_return) ←
    verifier.candidate.batch_tree_loop aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst proof root
      tree idx val hash lo n s keys 0#usize 0#usize
  match pending_return with
  | none => fail panic
  | some r => ok (r, idx1, val1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::batch_merkle_values]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 162:0-170:1 -/
def verifier.candidate.batch_merkle_values
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (queries : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
  (roots : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 3#usize) (batch : Std.Usize)
  (hash : H) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error)
  := do
  let idx := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32
  let a := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
  let val := Array.repeat 16#usize a
  let root0 ← Array.index_usize roots 0#usize
  let root1 ← Array.index_usize roots 1#usize
  let root2 ← Array.index_usize roots 2#usize
  let (r, idx1, val1) ←
    verifier.candidate.batch_tree aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst proof queries
      root0 batch 0#usize idx val hash
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    let (r1, idx2, val2) ←
      verifier.candidate.batch_tree aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst proof queries
        root1 batch 1#usize idx1 val1 hash
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let (r2, _, _) ←
        verifier.candidate.batch_tree aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst proof
          queries root2 batch 2#usize idx2 val2 hash
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      Unit (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::batch_merkle]:

def verifier.candidate.batch_merkle
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
  (folded_root : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (batch : Std.Usize) (hash : H) :
  Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error)
  := do
  let root0 ← Array.index_usize p.roots 0#usize
  let root1 ← Array.index_usize p.roots 1#usize
  verifier.candidate.batch_merkle_values aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst proof
    p.queries (Array.make 3#usize [ root0, root1, folded_root ]) batch hash

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::update_residue_row]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 237:4-241:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body
  (limbs : Array Std.U32 4#usize) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize)
  (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize) (basis : aspis_core.field.M31) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) × (Array Std.U64
    4#usize) × aspis_core.field.M31) (Array Std.U64 4#usize))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done row)
  | some j =>
    let old ← verifier.residue_limb_at row j
    let limb ← verifier.power_limb_at limbs j
    let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from limb)
    let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from basis)
    let i2 ← i * i1
    let i3 ← old + i2
    let row1 ← Array.update row j i3
    ok (cont (iter1, row1, basis))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::update_residue_row]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 237:4-241:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop0
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize)
  (basis : aspis_core.field.M31) (limbs : Array Std.U32 4#usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 4#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, row1, basis1) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop0.body limbs
      iter1 row1 basis1)
    (iter, row, basis)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::update_residue_row]: loop body 1:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 243:8-243:64 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64) ×
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64))
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64))
  := do
  let (o, iter1, next_back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (fun im => let im1 := next_back im none
                                back im1))
  | some limb =>
    let i ← lift (limb &&& 2147483647#u64)
    let i1 ← limb >>> 31#i32
    let limb1 ← i + i1
    ok (cont (iter1, fun im => let im1 := next_back im (some limb1)
                               back im1))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::update_residue_row]: loop 1:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 243:8-243:64 -/
@[rust_loop]
def verifier.update_residue_row_loop1
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  :
  Result (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U64)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, back1) => verifier.update_residue_row_loop1.body iter1 back1)
    (iter, back)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::update_residue_row]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 235:0-245:1 -/
def verifier.update_residue_row
  (row : Array Std.U64 4#usize) (power : aspis_core.field.QM31)
  (basis : aspis_core.field.M31) (flush : Bool) :
  Result (Array Std.U64 4#usize)
  := do
  let i := power.c0.a
  let i1 := power.c0.b
  let i2 := power.c1.a
  let i3 := power.c1.b
  let row1 ←
    verifier.update_residue_row_loop0 { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize }
      row basis (Array.make 4#usize [ i, i1, i2, i3 ])
  if flush
  then
    let (iter, into_iter_back) ←
      MutAArray.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorMutATIterMut.into_iter
        row1
    let back ← verifier.update_residue_row_loop1 iter (fun im => im)
    ok (into_iter_back back)
  else ok row1

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::BatchedWeights}::push]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 217:4-220:5 -/
def verifier.BatchedWeights.push
  (self : verifier.BatchedWeights) (index : Std.Usize)
  (power : aspis_core.field.QM31) (basis : aspis_core.field.M31) :
  Result verifier.BatchedWeights
  := do
  let i ← lift (self.terms &&& 3#usize)
  let (a, index_mut_back) ←
    alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array
      Std.U64 4#usize)) self.«raw» index
  let a1 ← verifier.update_residue_row a power basis (i = 3#usize)
  let v := index_mut_back a1
  ok { self with «raw» := v }

def verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0.body
  (node : aspis_core.field.M31) (n : Std.Usize)
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize)
  (basis : Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize) :

    let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m node

    let basis1 ← Array.update basis i m1
    ok (cont (iter1, basis1))

def verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0.body
  (m : aspis_core.field.M31) (width : Std.Usize) (node : aspis_core.field.M31)
  (basis : Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize) (n : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow (aspis_core.field.M31 × (Array aspis_core.field.M31
    256#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize))
  := do
  if n < width
  then
    let basis1 ←
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0_loop0
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := n } node basis n
    let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul node node
    let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.double m1
    let node1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m2 m
    let n1 ← n * 2#usize
    ok (cont (node1, basis1, n1))
  else ok (done basis)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::accumulate_batched_with_node]: loop body 2:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 281:4-286:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
  (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) (q : aspis_core.field.QM31)
  (i : Std.Usize) (width : Std.Usize)
  (basis : Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize)
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (weights : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) ×
    verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.BatchedWeights)
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done weights)
  | some j =>
    let m ← verifier.basis_at basis j
    let weights1 ← verifier.BatchedWeights.push weights j q m
    let i1 ← i * width
    let i2 ← i1 + j
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref v
    let q1 ← verifier.accumulated_weight_at s j
    let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31 q1
    trace.value 12#u16 i2 we
    let i3 ← i1 + j
    let we1 ←
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.Aspis_coreR0ScalarCodeField.from_m31
        m
    trace.value 13#u16 i3 we1
    ok (cont (iter1, weights1))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::accumulate_batched_with_node]: loop 2:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 281:4-286:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize)
  (v : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) (q : aspis_core.field.QM31)
  (i : Std.Usize) (weights : verifier.BatchedWeights) (width : Std.Usize)
  (basis : Array aspis_core.field.M31 256#usize) :
  Result verifier.BatchedWeights
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, weights1) => verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1.body
      v q i width basis iter1 weights1)
    (iter, weights)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::accumulate_batched_with_node]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 277:0-290:1 -/
def verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node
  (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
  (node : aspis_core.field.M31) (value : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
  (weights : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
  Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights)
  := do
  let width := alloc.vec.Vec.len a.weights
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO
  let basis := Array.repeat 256#usize m
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
  let basis1 ← Array.update basis 0#usize m1
  let basis2 ←
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop0 m1 node width basis1 1#usize
  let weights1 ←
    verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node_loop1
      { start := 0#usize, «end» := width } a.weights a.power a.next weights
      width basis2
  let i ← weights1.terms + 1#usize
  let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_qm31 value a.power
  let we1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a.rhs we
  trace.value 11#u16 a.next we1
  let q ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul a.power p.rho
  let i1 ← a.next + 1#usize
  ok ({ a with rhs := we1, power := q, next := i1 },
    { weights1 with terms := i })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::line_fold_with_inverses]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 191:0-200:1 -/
def verifier.line_fold_with_inverses
  (alpha : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
  (a : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 4#usize)
  (inverse : Array aspis_core.field.M31 5#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let ix ← Array.index_usize inverse 2#usize
  let iy ← Array.index_usize inverse 3#usize
  let iz ← Array.index_usize inverse 4#usize
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a1 b
  let we1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we c
  let we2 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we1 d
  let m ← weights.QUARTER
  let h0 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we2 m
  let we3 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we c
  let we4 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we3 d
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m iz
  let h2 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we4 m1
  let we5 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub a1 b
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul 1073741824#u32 ix
  let c0 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we5 m2
  let we6 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub d c
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul 1073741824#u32 iy
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we6 m3
  let we7 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add c0 c1
  let h1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we7 1073741824#u32
  let we8 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub c0 c1
  let m4 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul 1073741824#u32 iz
  let h3 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we8 m4
  let we9 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha h3
  let we10 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h2 we9
  let we11 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha we10
  let we12 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h1 we11
  let we13 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha we12
  aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h0 we13

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::circle_fold_with_inverses]:

def verifier.circle_fold_with_inverses
  (alpha : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
  (a : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 4#usize)
  (inverse : Array aspis_core.field.M31 5#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let ix ← Array.index_usize inverse 0#usize
  let iy ← Array.index_usize inverse 1#usize
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize a 0#usize
  let b ← Array.index_usize a 1#usize
  let c ← Array.index_usize a 2#usize
  let d ← Array.index_usize a 3#usize
  let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add a1 b
  let we1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we c
  let we2 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we1 d
  let m ← weights.QUARTER
  let h0 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we2 m
  let we3 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub a1 b
  let we4 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we3 c
  let we5 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we4 d
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m iy
  let h1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we5 m1
  let we6 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we c
  let we7 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we6 d
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m ix
  let h2 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we7 m2
  let we8 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add we3 c
  let we9 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.sub we8 d
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m ix
  let m4 ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul m3 iy
  let h3 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 we9 m4
  let we10 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha h3
  let we11 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h2 we10
  let we12 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha we11
  let we13 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h1 we12
  let we14 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul alpha we13
  aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add h0 we14

  (self : verifier.QueryGeometry) (index : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.M31 5#usize)
  := do
  let i ← index - self.start
  alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (Array
    aspis_core.field.M31 5#usize)) self.inverses i

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::mark]:

def verifier.mark
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (p : verifier.Phase) :
  Result Unit
  := do
  match obs with
  | none => ok ()

    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs

  let q1 ← core.option.Option.unwrap o1
  let (r, tail1) ← fast_pairing.EbyKDot.push tail we q1
  core.result.Result.unwrap core.fmt.DebugUnit r
  let i11 ← slot * 32#usize

  let i13 ← 0#usize * 16#usize

def fast_dots.four_dots
  (q : Slice Std.U8) (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
  :
  Result (Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 4#usize)
  := do
  let s ←
    core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice
      Std.U8) q { «end» := 608#usize }
  let r ← core.array.TryFromSharedArraySlice.try_from 608#usize s
  let q1 ← core.result.Result.unwrap core.fmt.DebugTryFromSliceError r
  let we ← fast_dots.four_dots_one q1 g 0#usize

  let we2 ← fast_dots.four_dots_one q1 g 2#usize
  let we3 ← fast_dots.four_dots_one q1 g 3#usize
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ we, we1, we2, we3 ])

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::query_values]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 212:0-235:1 -/
def verifier.candidate.query_values
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
  (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (pending : verifier.BatchedWeights) :
  Result (core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights)
    verifier.Error)
  := do
  let i ← Array.index_usize p.queries a.next
  let u ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i)
  let q ← verifier.candidate.opening proof a.next
  let dots ← fast_dots.four_dots q g
  let i1 ← 4#usize * a.next
  let we ← Array.index_usize dots 0#usize
  trace.value 9#u16 i1 we
  let i2 ← i1 + 1#usize
  let we1 ← Array.index_usize dots 1#usize
  trace.value 9#u16 i2 we1
  let i3 ← i1 + 2#usize
  let we2 ← Array.index_usize dots 2#usize
  trace.value 9#u16 i3 we2
  let i4 ← i1 + 3#usize
  let we3 ← Array.index_usize dots 3#usize
  trace.value 9#u16 i4 we3
  let inverse ← verifier.QueryGeometry.for_query geometry a.next
  let we4 ← Array.index_usize p.alpha 0#usize
  let folded ← verifier.circle_fold_with_inverses we4 dots inverse
  let i5 ← 2#usize * a.next
  trace.value 10#u16 i5 folded
  let values ←
    core.array.from_fn 4#usize
      verifier.candidate.query_values.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeWideExact
      q
  let i6 ← u % 4#usize
  let we5 ← Array.index_usize values i6
  let b ←
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
      aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqWideExact
      folded we5
  if b
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err verifier.Error.Query)
  else
    let we6 ← Array.index_usize p.alpha 1#usize
    let folded1 ← verifier.line_fold_with_inverses we6 values inverse
    let i7 ← i5 + 1#usize
    trace.value 10#u16 i7 folded1
    let i8 ← a.next - geometry.start
    let z ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
        aspis_core.field.M31) geometry.line_z i8
    let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.mul z z
    let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.double m
    let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
    let node ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m1 m2
    let (a1, pending1) ←
      verifier.accumulate_batched_with_node p a node folded1 pending
    verifier.mark obs (verifier.Phase.Query a.next)
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (a1, pending1))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::query_loop]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 242:8-249:13 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop.body
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
  (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (end1 : Std.Usize)
  (state : core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights)
  verifier.Error) :
  Result (ControlFlow (core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator ×
    verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.Error) (core.result.Result
    (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights) verifier.Error))
  := do
  match state with
  | core.result.Result.Ok p1 =>
    let (a, pending) := p1
    if a.next >= end1
    then ok (done state)
    else
      let state1 ←
        verifier.candidate.query_values proof p a g obs geometry pending
      ok (cont state1)
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (done state)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::candidate::query_loop]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/candidate.rs', lines 242:8-249:13 -/
@[rust_loop]
def verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop
  (state : core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights)
  verifier.Error) (proof : Slice Std.U8) (p : verifier.Prepared)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
  (geometry : verifier.QueryGeometry) (end1 : Std.Usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result (verifier.Accumulator × verifier.BatchedWeights)
    verifier.Error)
  := do
  loop
    (fun state1 => verifier.candidate.query_loop_loop.body proof p g obs
      geometry end1 state1)
    state

def verifier.candidate.query_loop
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::{impl core::cmp::PartialEq<aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::Variant> for aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::Variant}::eq]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transport.rs', lines 2:26-2:35
    Visibility: public -/
def transport.Variant.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqVariant.eq
  (self : transport.Variant) (other : transport.Variant) : Result Bool := do
  let self1 := read_discriminant self
  let other1 := read_discriminant other
  ok (self1 = other1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::Variant}::folds]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transport.rs', lines 8:4-8:72
    Visibility: public -/
def transport.Variant.folds (self : transport.Variant) : Result Std.Usize := do
  let b ←
    transport.Variant.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqVariant.eq self
      transport.Variant.S1
  if b
  then ok 1#usize
  else ok 2#usize

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::Transcript<H>}::absorb]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 14:4-16:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.absorb
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8) (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (transcript.Transcript H)
  := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
  let i ← 160#u8 + row
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ 0#u8, i ]))
  let i1 := Slice.len payload
  let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i1)
  let a ← lift (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes i2)
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 4#usize [ s, s1, s2, payload ]))
  let a1 ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self.hash s3
  ok { self with state := a1 }

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::Transcript<H>}::block]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 17:4-22:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.block
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8) (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((Array Std.U8 32#usize) × (transcript.Transcript H))
  := do
  let self1 ←
    transcript.Transcript.absorb aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row payload
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s, s1 ]))
  let block ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s2
  let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice self1.state)
  let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
  let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
  let a ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest self1.hash s5
  ok (block, { self1 with state := a })

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_div_pass]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 11:4-16:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64 × Std.Usize) ((Array
    Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64))
  := do
  if j > 0#usize
  then
    let j1 ← j - 1#usize
    let i ← remainder <<< 32#i32
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize rank j1
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i1)
    let dividend ← lift (i ||| i2)
    let i3 ← aspis_core.field.P
    let i4 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i3)
    let i5 ← dividend / i4
    let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank j1 i6
    let i7 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i3)
    let remainder1 ← dividend % i7
    ok (cont (rank1, remainder1, j1))
  else ok (done (rank, remainder))

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_div_pass]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 11:4-16:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (remainder : Std.U64) (j : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U64)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, remainder1, j1) => sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop.body rank1
      remainder1 j1)
    (rank, remainder, j)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_div_pass]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 8:0-18:1 -/
def sampler.qm31_div_pass
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) :
  Result ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.U32)
  := do
  let (rank1, remainder) ← sampler.qm31_div_pass_loop rank 0#u64 8#usize
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 remainder)
  ok (rank1, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_digits]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 24:4-33:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32
    8#usize))
  := do
  if i < 8#usize
  then
    let start ← 4#usize * i
    let i1 ← Array.index_usize block start
    let i2 ← start + 1#usize
    let i3 ← Array.index_usize block i2
    let i4 ← start + 2#usize
    let i5 ← Array.index_usize block i4
    let i6 ← start + 3#usize
    let i7 ← Array.index_usize block i6
    let i8 ←
      lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7 ]))
    let rank1 ← Array.update rank i i8
    let i9 ← i + 1#usize
    ok (cont (rank1, i9))
  else ok (done rank)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_digits]: loop 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 24:4-33:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler.qm31_digits_loop0
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, i1) => sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body block rank1 i1)
    (rank, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_digits]: loop body 1:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 36:4-41:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler.qm31_digits_loop1.body
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((Array Std.U32 8#usize) × (Array Std.U32 4#usize) ×
    Std.Usize) (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
  := do
  if i < 4#usize
  then
    let (quotient, digit) ← sampler.qm31_div_pass rank
    let digits1 ← Array.update digits i digit
    let i1 ← i + 1#usize
    ok (cont (quotient, digits1, i1))
  else ok (done digits)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_digits]: loop 1:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 36:4-41:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler.qm31_digits_loop1
  (rank : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (digits : Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize)
  := do
  loop
    (fun (rank1, digits1, i1) => sampler.qm31_digits_loop1.body rank1 digits1
      i1)
    (rank, digits, i)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_digits]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 21:0-43:1 -/
def sampler.qm31_digits
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) : Result (Array Std.U32 4#usize) := do
  let rank := Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32
  let rank1 ← sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block rank 0#usize
  let digits := Array.repeat 4#usize 0#u32
  sampler.qm31_digits_loop1 rank1 digits 0#usize

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::sampler::qm31_sample]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 45:0-51:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler.qm31_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let digits ← sampler.qm31_digits block
  let i ← Array.index_usize digits 0#usize
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits 1#usize
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize digits 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize digits 3#usize
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i2 i3
  ok { c0 := c, c1 }

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::Transcript<H>}::scalar_k]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 31:4-34:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.scalar_k
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8) (payload : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.QM31 × (transcript.Transcript H))
  := do
  let (a, self1) ←
    transcript.Transcript.block aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row payload
  let out ← sampler.qm31_sample a
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize row)
  let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_qm31 out
  trace.value 4#u16 i we
  ok (out, self1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::Transcript<H>}::scalar]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 23:4-27:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.scalar
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (self : transcript.Transcript H) (row : Std.U8) (payload : Slice Std.U8)
  (nonzero : Bool) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact × (transcript.Transcript H))
  := do
  let (block, self1) ←
    transcript.Transcript.block aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst self row payload
  let out ←
    if nonzero
    then sampler.gamma_sample block
    else sampler.ordinary_sample block
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize row)
  trace.value 4#u16 i out
  ok (out, self1)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transcript::Transcript<H>}::new]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/transcript.rs', lines 7:4-13:5
    Visibility: public -/
def transcript.Transcript.new
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (hash : H) (semantic_state : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
  (variant : transport.Variant) :
  Result (transcript.Transcript H)
  := do
  let domain ←
    lift (Array.to_slice
      (Array.make 29#usize [
        85#u8, 78#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 79#u8, 86#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 82#u8,
        49#u8, 58#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 73#u8, 86#u8, 65#u8, 84#u8, 69#u8, 45#u8,
        83#u8, 65#u8, 76#u8, 84#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 80#u8, 51#u8
        ]))
  let i ← transport.Variant.tag variant
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ i ]))
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice semantic_state)
  let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ domain, s, s1 ]))
  let a ← aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst.digest hash s2
  ok { state := a, hash }

  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) :
  Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::verifier::Prepared}::new]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/verifier.rs', lines 72:4-89:5
    Visibility: public -/
def verifier.Prepared.new
  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result verifier.Prepared verifier.Error) × (Array
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize))
  := do
  let a ←
    r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst
      sem.transcript
  let t ←
    transcript.Transcript.new aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst hash a v.variant
  let (gamma, t1) ←
    transcript.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t 27#u8 v.y1 true
  let a1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes v.inactive
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
  let (kappa, t2) ←
    transcript.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t1 28#u8 s false
  let (alpha0, t3) ←
    transcript.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t2 29#u8 
      v.round0 false
  let i ← transport.Variant.folds v.variant
  if i = 2#usize
  then
    let i1 ← 32#usize + 224#usize
    let bytes := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U8 i1
    let a2 ← core.option.Option.unwrap v.folded_root
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice a2)
    let bytes1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes s1
    let bytes2 ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes1 v.round1
    let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2
    let (we, t4) ←
      transcript.Transcript.scalar aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t3 30#u8 s2
        false
    let (r, t5) ←
      transcript.Transcript.queries aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t4 31#u8
        v.final_message
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let i2 ← 31#u8 + 1#u8
      let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty Std.U8))
      let (rho, t6) ←
        transcript.Transcript.scalar_k aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t5 i2 s3
      let g1 ← weights.powers 29#usize gamma
      let r1 ←
        verifier.prepared_claim aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst sem v.y1
          v.inactive g1 kappa
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            variant := v.variant,
            roots := sem.roots,
            gamma,
            kappa,
            alpha := (Array.make 2#usize [ alpha0, we ]),
            rho,
            queries := val,
            semantic_alpha := sem.alpha,
            z := sem.z,
            claim := val1,
            state := t6.state
          }, g1)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        let r2 ←
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
        ok (r2, g1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (r1, g)
  else
    let we ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
    let (r, t4) ←
      transcript.Transcript.queries aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t3 30#u8
        v.final_message
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let i1 ← 30#u8 + 1#u8
      let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty Std.U8))
      let (rho, t5) ←
        transcript.Transcript.scalar_k aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst t4 i1 s1
      let g1 ← weights.powers 29#usize gamma
      let r1 ←
        verifier.prepared_claim aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst sem v.y1
          v.inactive g1 kappa
      let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf1 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            variant := v.variant,
            roots := sem.roots,
            gamma,
            kappa,
            alpha := (Array.make 2#usize [ alpha0, we ]),
            rho,
            queries := val,
            semantic_alpha := sem.alpha,
            z := sem.z,
            claim := val1,
            state := t5.state
          }, g1)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        let r2 ←
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
        ok (r2, g1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (r1, g)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::POINTS]

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::LANES]
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/r1_wire.rs', lines 13:0-13:28
    Visibility: public -/
@[global_simps, irreducible] def r1_wire.LANES : Std.Usize := 29#usize

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::CLAIMS]
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/r1_wire.rs', lines 15:0-15:41
    Visibility: public -/
@[global_simps, irreducible]
def r1_wire.CLAIMS : Result Std.Usize := r1_wire.POINTS * r1_wire.LANES

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::r1_wire::row_shape]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/r1_wire.rs', lines 39:0-49:1
    Visibility: public -/
def r1_wire.row_shape
  (row : Std.U8) : Result (Option (Std.U8 × Std.Usize)) := do
  match row with
  | 0#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 1#uscalar => ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
  | 2#uscalar => ok (some (1#u8, 32#usize))
  | 14#uscalar => ok (some (3#u8, 32#usize))
  | 25#uscalar =>
    let i ← r1_wire.CLAIMS
    let i1 ← i + r1_wire.LANES
    let i2 ← i1 * 32#usize
    ok (some (4#u8, i2))
  | 26#uscalar => let i ← r1_wire.LANES * 32#usize
                  ok (some (5#u8, i))
  | _ =>
    if 3#u8 <= row
    then
      if row <= 13#u8
      then ok (some (0#u8, 0#usize))
      else
        if 15#u8 <= row
        then
          if row <= 24#u8
          then let i ← 28#usize * 32#usize
               ok (some (2#u8, i))
          else ok none
        else ok none
    else
      if 15#u8 <= row
      then
        if row <= 24#u8
        then let i ← 28#usize * 32#usize
             ok (some (2#u8, i))
        else ok none
      else ok none

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::compact::compact_row]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/compact.rs', lines 80:0-82:1 -/
def compact.compact_row (row : Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  ok (row >= 14#u8)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::compact::SEMANTIC_ROWS]

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::compact::expand_semantic]: loop body 0:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/compact.rs', lines 154:4-172:1
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def compact.expand_semantic_loop.body
  (compact : Slice Std.U8) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U8)
  (out : Slice Std.U8) (src : Std.Usize) (dst : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.ops.range.Range Std.U8) × (Slice Std.U8) ×
    Std.Usize × Std.Usize) ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) ×
    (Slice Std.U8)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepU8 iter
  match o with
  | none =>
    let i := Slice.len compact
    if src != i
    then ok (done (core.result.Result.Err compact.CodecError.Length, out))
    else
      let i1 := Slice.len out
      if dst != i1
      then ok (done (core.result.Result.Err compact.CodecError.Length, out))
      else ok (done (core.result.Result.Ok (), out))
  | some row =>
    let o1 ← r1_wire.row_shape row
    let r ← core.option.Option.ok_or o1 compact.CodecError.Length
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let (_, size) := val
      let i ← dst + 5#usize
      let (s, index_mut_back) ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) out
          { start := dst, «end» := i }
      let i1 ← src + 5#usize
      let s1 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) compact
          { start := src, «end» := i1 }
      let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
      let out1 := index_mut_back s2
      let b ← compact.compact_row row
      if b
      then
        let i2 ← size / 2#usize
        let i3 ← i1 + i2
        let s3 ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) compact
            { start := i1, «end» := i3 }
        let i4 ← i + size
        let (s4, index_mut_back1) ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) out1
            { start := i, «end» := i4 }
        let (r1, s5) ← compact.expand_values s3 s4
        let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
        match cf1 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
          let out2 := index_mut_back1 s5
          let src1 ← i1 + i2
          ok (cont (iter1, out2, src1, i4))
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          let r2 ←
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              Unit (core.convert.FromSame compact.CodecError) residual
          let out2 := index_mut_back1 s5
          ok (done (r2, out2))
      else
        let i2 ← i + size
        let (s3, index_mut_back1) ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) out1
            { start := i, «end» := i2 }
        let i3 ← i1 + size
        let s4 ←
          core.slice.index.Slice.index
            (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) compact
            { start := i1, «end» := i3 }
        let s5 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s3 s4
        let out2 := index_mut_back1 s5
        ok (cont (iter1, out2, i3, i2))
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame compact.CodecError) residual
      ok (done (r1, out))

@[rust_loop]
def compact.expand_semantic_loop
  (iter : core.ops.range.Range Std.U8) (compact : Slice Std.U8)
  (out : Slice Std.U8) (src : Std.Usize) (dst : Std.Usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) × (Slice Std.U8))
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, out1, src1, dst1) => compact.expand_semantic_loop.body compact
      iter1 out1 src1 dst1)
    (iter, out, src, dst)

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::compact::expand_semantic]:

    Visibility: public -/
def compact.expand_semantic
  (compact : Slice Std.U8) (out : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) × (Slice Std.U8))
  := do
  let i := Slice.len compact
  let i1 ← compact.COMPACT_SEMANTIC
  if i != i1
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err compact.CodecError.Length, out)
  else
    let i2 := Slice.len out
    let i3 ← compact.LOGICAL_SEMANTIC
    if i2 != i3
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err compact.CodecError.Length, out)
    else
      let (s, index_mut_back) ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) out
          { «end» := 32#usize }
      let s1 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) compact
          { «end» := 32#usize }
      let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
      let out1 := index_mut_back s2
      compact.expand_semantic_loop
        { start := 0#u8, «end» := compact.SEMANTIC_ROWS } compact out1
        32#usize 32#usize

  {H : Type} (aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
  (public1 : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
  (proof : Slice Std.U8) (hash : H)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
  (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize) :
  Result ((core.result.Result verifier.Prepared verifier.Error) × (Array
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize))
  := do
  let i ← compact.LOGICAL_SEMANTIC
  let i1 ← compact.LOGICAL_Y1
  let i2 ← i + i1
  let r ← aspis_core.r0.heap.filled core.marker.CopyU8 i2 0#u8
  let r1 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      (verifier.candidate.prepare.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
      aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst) r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let (s, deref_mut_back) ← lift (alloc.vec.Vec.deref_mut val)
    let ((semantic, y1), split_at_mut_back) ←
      core.slice.Slice.split_at_mut s i
    let i3 ← compact.OFF_Y1
    let s1 ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice
        Std.U8) proof { start := compact.OFF_SEMANTIC, «end» := i3 }
    let (r2, semantic1) ← compact.expand_semantic s1 semantic
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let i4 ← compact.OFF_INACTIVE
      let s2 ←
        core.slice.index.Slice.index
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) proof
          { start := i3, «end» := i4 }
      let (r3, y11) ← compact.expand_values s2 y1
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        let s3 := split_at_mut_back (semantic1, y11)
        let val1 := deref_mut_back s3
        let s4 ←
          alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice
            Std.U8) val1 { «end» := i }
        let s5 ←
          alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice
            Std.U8) val1 { start := i }
        let r4 ← verifier.candidate.wide_view proof s4 s5
        let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
        match cf3 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue v =>
          let r5 ←
            r1_semantic.verify_observed aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst public1
              v.semantic hash obs
          let r6 ←
            core.result.Result.map_err
              (verifier.candidate.prepare.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
              aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst) r5 ()
          let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r6
          match cf4 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
            verifier.mark obs verifier.Phase.Semantic
            verifier.Prepared.new aspis_coredigestDigest32Inst val2 v hash g
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            let r7 ←
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
                residual
            ok (r7, g)
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          let r5 ←
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
          ok (r5, g)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        let r4 ←
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            verifier.Prepared verifier.Error.Insts.CoreConvertFromCodecError
            residual
        ok (r4, g)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r3 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          verifier.Prepared verifier.Error.Insts.CoreConvertFromCodecError
          residual
      ok (r3, g)

      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

    core.result.Result.map_err
      verifier.BatchedWeights.new.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError
      r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let raw1 ← verifier.BatchedWeights.new_loop weights val 0#usize
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok { «raw» := raw1, terms := 0#usize })
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.BatchedWeights (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

/-- [aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::{aspis_r1_cost_probe::transport::Variant}::final_len]:
